Project 01
Machine Learning Healthcare Tech Mini Project

FocusCheck — Accommodative Infacility Detection & CPM Analysis System

A vision-based diagnostic system that detects accommodative infacility — a condition where the eyes struggle to shift focus between near and far objects — by analyzing Critical Pulse Metric (CPM) through camera input. Delivers real-time insights into visual focus disorders frequently missed in routine screenings.

PythonOpenCVComputer VisionMachine LearningCPM Analysis
  • Designed the detection pipeline to track eye accommodation response patterns and compute CPM in real-time through frame-by-frame analysis
  • Built an intuitive interface for clinical or self-screening use, with threshold indicators and diagnostic output visualization
  • Focused on accessibility — enabling non-specialist users to run preliminary screenings without expensive equipment
  • Bridging the gap between visual health awareness and affordable, technology-driven diagnostic tools
